# `omapac aur build`

- **Usage:** `omapac aur build [--commit <COMMIT>] [-J --json] <PACKAGE>`

Build an approved AUR package without installing it

Sources are fetched with network, then makepkg runs in the jail with writes limited to the build directory and no network unless the manifest grants it. Prints the package files it built.

## Arguments
- **`<PACKAGE>`** — The package name

## Flags
- **`--commit <COMMIT>`** — Build this commit instead of the approved one
- **`-J --json`** — Print the files as JSON
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
